facts.fact: The Direction Generale du Budget (Ministry of Finance) states that the deadline set for the entry into force of Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on personal data protection was reached on 23 June 2026, and that the law is now officially in force.
facts.system: Loi n° 2024/017 du 23 décembre 2024 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The law's entry into force on 23 June 2026, within the last twelve months, is reported by the Direction Generale du Budget in a post of 6 July 2026.
facts.system: Loi n° 2024/017 du 23 décembre 2024 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel
